titulo: Where Do All the Bugs Go in Winter?
titulos_alternativos: What Happens to Every Bug in Your Yard When Winter Comes
Winter Doesn't Kill the Bugs. It Hides Them
descripcion:
In summer your backyard is full of bees, crickets, butterflies and mosquitoes. Then the first hard frost arrives and everything goes silent. A few months later, they are all back. So where did they go?

Some fly across a continent. Some shiver all winter to stay warm. Some move into your walls. And one of them freezes solid and walks away in spring.

In this video: monarch butterflies, honey bees, bumble bee queens, ladybugs, stink bugs, woolly bear caterpillars, mourning cloak butterflies, cocoons, mosquitoes, ants, fireflies, cicadas, dragonflies, praying mantises and snow fleas, and the easiest thing you can do to help them: leave the leaves.
